_about: Conyers Middleton (1683-1750), Principal Librarian to the University of Cambridge: The History of the Life of Marcus Tullius Cicero (first published 1741), the standard English life of Cicero for a century. Two-volume London edition of 1819 (J. Cuthell and others), raw IA. Middleton's theological works (the Free Inquiry) are lane A's if wanted; this shelf is the classical biography only.

conyers-middleton-life-of-cicero-1819-v1: The Life of M. Tullius Cicero, in two volumes, vol. I (London: J. Cuthell and others, 1819)
conyers-middleton-life-of-cicero-1819-v2: The Life of M. Tullius Cicero, in two volumes, vol. II, with index (London, 1819)
